name: Journey to Entorus
author: Marcus Ramse
description: A bullet hell with a short story: make your way to Entorus, and maybe back. Includes a Practice Mode and a harder Extra Story. Arrows to move, X and Z for the ship.

descriptions.en: A bullet hell with a short story: make your way to Entorus, and maybe back. Includes a Practice Mode and a harder Extra Story. Arrows to move, X and Z for the ship.
descriptions.it: Un bullet hell con una breve storia: raggiungi Entorus e forse torna indietro. C'è una modalità pratica e una storia extra più difficile. Frecce per muoverti, X e Z per la nave.
